titulo_es: Il «si» impersonale e le regole dell-ufficio

texto: To generalize or express impersonal prayers («work», «se come», «se dice») the Italian places the particle **si** in front of the verb in **tercera persona del singular**: **Qui si lavora con impegno** (here we work with dedication); **In Italia si mangia bene** (in Italy we eat well); **Come si scrive?** (how do we write?).

**è vietato + infinitivo** (is prohibited) or **si può + infinitivo** (can) is used to regulate public and office behaviour: **È vietato fumare** (is prohibited from smoking); **Qui si può entrare?** (can you enter here?).

bloques.titulo: Vocabulary: rules of living, working environment and warnings
A gift of the nuovo uffice

frases.it: Dimmi, Matteo: qui si lavora anche il sabato mattina?
frases.es: Dime, Matteo: ¿aquí se trabaja también los sábados por la mañana?
frases.en: Tell me, Matteo, are you working here on Saturdays in the morning too?

frases.it: No, dal lunedì al venerdì! A mezzogiorno si fa una pausa di un'ora per il pranzo.
frases.es: ¡No, de lunes a viernes! A mediodía se hace una pausa de una hora para comer.
frases.en: No, Monday to Friday! At noon, a one-hour break is made for lunch.

frases.it: E nelle sale comuni si può fumare o usare il telefono?
frases.es: ¿Y en las salas comunes se puede fumar o usar el teléfono?
frases.en: And can you smoke or use the phone in the common rooms?

frases.it: Assolutamente no: è severamente vietato fumare in tutto l'edificio.
frases.es: En absoluto: está rigurosamente prohibido fumar en todo el edificio.
frases.en: Not at all: smoking is strictly prohibited throughout the building.

bloques.pregunta: How do you say «here you speak Italian» with the impersonal structure?

opciones.explicacion: The «si» particle immediately precedes the third-person verb singular.
The impersonal particle is never postponed to the conjugated verb.
With singular noun or as a general language the verb remains in singular.

bloques.pregunta: What is the normative meaning of the «È vietato fumare» signal?

opciones.texto: It's strictly forbidden to smoke in that area.
Se autoriza el consumo moderado de tabaco.
It is compulsory to apply for a prior permit to smoke.
opciones.explicacion: It expresses a clear prohibition without exception.

bloques.frase: In questo ufficio ___ lavora con grande professionalità.

opciones.explicacion: «Si lavora» is the standard impersonal construction in third person singular.
It is pronoun of first person plural or adverbian of place.
It is direct pronoun masculine singular.

bloques.pregunta: What general statement does the prayer make?
bloques.frase: In Italia si mangia molto bene in ogni regione.

opciones.texto: That in any Italian region food is of high quality.
opciones.explicacion: «Si mangia molto bene» makes a general and positive judgment on gastronomy.

opciones.texto: That all Italians must eat in expensive restaurants.
opciones.explicacion: It does not refer to prices but to shared quality.

opciones.texto: It's forbidden to cook regional dishes at home.

bloques.pregunta: Why does the verb go in plural («si prendono»)?
bloques.frase: Durante la riunione di lavoro si prendono decisioni importanti.

opciones.texto: Porque concuerda con el sujeto paciente plural pospuesto («decisioni importanti»).
opciones.explicacion: It is a passive construction with «si»: the verb matches the plural element.

opciones.texto: Because the implicit subject is the «noi» collective.
Because «si» is a plural tonic pronoun.
opciones.explicacion: «Si» is an atone and adopts agreement according to the nominal synthagma.

bloques.frase: In questo ristorante si mangia bene
bloques.traduccion: In this restaurant you eat well
bloques.explicacion: Classic impersonal structure with «si» + verb in singular.

bloques.pregunta: What is the right way to say «work»?

opciones.explicacion: «si» particle opposite the verb in third person singular.
I'd only go in plural if there was a patient subject in plural.
Archaic enclisis uncharacteristic of the current contemporary Italian.

intro: Learn to formulate general rules, warnings and neutral instructions using impersonal «si» particle.
